title: SpaceX and xAI Are Merging Into a Very Silly-Sounding Conglomerate. Take It Seriously
content:
SpaceX is acquiring xAI. Ever since this merger of two Musk companies became a rumor, crazy numbers like $1.5 trillion started being thrown around when discussing the total valuation of SpaceX, so you might sum it up by saying “Combining SpaceX and xAI gets you the biggest IPO of all time!” and yeah, that’s more plausible now than ever. For reference, SpaceX’s valuation was estimated at around $800 billion less than two months ago.   
  
But is this merger as silly as it sounds? [...] In other words, we’re headed for a time when the Wall Street bulls will have to be right. More than ever Elon Musk’s caprice may have to actually be wisdom, as implausible as that may be. AI had better not be a bubble if this IPO goes well, and the value of Musk himself had better not be inflated either. All of our well-being may just depend on it.
